summary:
I worked the CRC outreach worklist for 'Okafor CRC 2026' (grp-okafor-crc, 4 members) under RBC-QM-02. Three patients have an open gap and one is excluded.

| Patient | Age at end of 2026 | Status | Reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| pt-0009 Elly Trantow | 72 | Open gap | No colonoscopy, sigmoidoscopy, CT colonography or stool test on record. She takes donepezil for dementia, but the frailty exclusion needs an active frailty diagnosis too. Her only one (cond-00189, 2025-09-16) was marked entered in error today by Dr. Lin: it belonged to another patient (comm-00301). No nursing-home or hospice/palliative care record. FIT kit ordered (sr-t0001, window 10/23 to 12/31/2026); outreach message sent (comm-t0004). |
| pt-0020 Kelsie Rohan | 52 | Excluded | Hospice care during 2026: episode eoc-00002, active 06/16 to 08/21/2026, now finished, for pancreatic cancer. The outside hospice discharge summary (doc-00402) that arrived today confirms it; she left hospice to join a clinical trial, and a finished episode still excludes her. No order and no contact. |
| pt-0022 Tiny Koss | 52 | Open gap | Her only FIT (obs-01732) was corrected today: the sample was collected 12/31/2025, and 01/05/2026 was the date the lab received it. A stool test counts by collection date, so it is outside the 2026 measurement period. No other screening and no exclusions. FIT kit ordered (sr-t0002); outreach message sent (comm-t0005). |
| pt-0024 Delaine MacGyver | 51 | Open gap | Her only stool DNA-FIT result (obs-01871, collected 06/11/2024) is now entered in error. Harbor Lab's notice of corrected report (doc-00401) says the specimen belonged to another patient. Her 2025 colonoscopy referral (sr-00003, still active) was never done, and a referral is not screening. No exclusions and no active FIT order. FIT kit ordered (sr-t0003); outreach message sent (comm-t0006). |

- **Results that arrived while I worked:** four items came in after I started (inbox-a0001 to a0004). Three of them turned patients I had first assessed as excluded (pt-0009) or up to date (pt-0022, pt-0024) into open gaps. I hadn't recorded those first decisions yet, so I acted only on the corrected information; nothing had to be reversed. I closed all four items with a comment explaining the decision and linked each to the related order and message.
- **Outreach messages:** each says the kit is on its way and how to complete and return it by 12/31/2026. None makes any claim about the patient's past screening.
- **Not done:** I didn't write chart notes, contacted no one without an open gap, and wrote nothing about anyone outside the group. Your other open inbox items, which aren't part of this worklist, are untouched.
